## Invitations

The outreach recorded 2295 invitations and 602 attendances. The attendance rate was 26.2 per cent. These figures provide the overall response to the invitations issued during the reporting period.

Attendance is reported as the number of people who attended in relation to the number invited. The recorded rate provides a concise measure of participation and should be considered alongside the total invitation and attendance figures.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS, with the recorded SMS total at 0. The number of people receiving a reminder message was also 0. Accordingly, the contact figures show no recorded use of SMS invitations or reminder messages during this period.

This report presents the invitation, attendance, and contact information in a clear summary for routine monitoring. The figures can support review of outreach activity and inform consideration of future contact arrangements.
